name: IHIRecordStatus
title: IHI Record Status
description: This extension applies to the [Identifier](http://hl7.org/fhir/datatypes.html#identifier) data type and is used to indicate whether verification of the Individual Healthcare Identifier (IHI) has occurred and is based on the evidence available for a person’s identity.

element.definition: Known IHI record status associated with an IHI identifier.

element.comment: This concept is equivalent to Australian Institute of Health and Welfare data element 743464 [Identifier—record status, Individual Healthcare Identifier record status code N](https://meteor.aihw.gov.au/content/index.phtml/itemId/743464).
